terms.statement: The timescale that decides solid-vs-fluid response: the mantle carries S-waves over seconds yet convects over Myr; it sets the rebound clock used in M44.
Rapid continental break-up as a jamming→unjamming transition once the effective stress exceeds the yield surface; the inherited geodynamics engine the cascade re-runs (39/39 PASS).
On a fixed-size globe, opening one ocean must be balanced by closing elsewhere — an exact bookkeeping identity that anchors the Continental-Genesis import (M45).
Crust bending under ice and springing back after; the forebulge and marine limit record the former load, and ongoing uplift is the present-tense recency clock.
Mostly-stuck motion with rare fast slips; a slow average speed can be rare fast events spread thinly, so a present speed cannot by itself date onset.
Microbes eat the light fractions of oil in cool, shallow, oxygen-reached reservoirs, leaving it heavy; the process shuts off above ~80 °C.
Organic-rich rock that later generates oil; it needs a quiet, oxygen-starved (anoxic) setting to preserve the organic matter.
A self-check inside each script: it hashes its own output twice and refuses to pass unless the hash matches the pinned value — proof the result has not drifted.
The fixed random-seed convention so every load-bearing computation is deterministic and reproducible.

Glacial meltwater does opposite things to oxygen at two depths: sealing it out deep (preserving source rock) and bringing it in shallow (making oil heavy); reproduces oil quality across 6/6 provinces (M42).
A layer of fresh meltwater sitting on heavier seawater stops oxygen reaching the bottom → the bottom goes anoxic → organic matter is preserved (the source-rock preservation half of the dual-redox).

The single load-bearing release that drives the coupled cascade; the deep-water inventory is bounded present-tense and exceeds the largest requirement by ~10× [V] (M50), but the releasable fraction and mechanism stay open [O].
The one genuinely-discriminating cross-system test; the protocol harness and canonical population are built (M49) but the decisive run stays open pending verified source volumes — no fabrication.

One untuned cause closes nine present-tense phenomena of the cascade with zero data-fitted parameters, where the mainstream uses eight independent mechanisms — an 8:1 compression in mechanism and parameter count (parsimony, not proof).

Order 10⁴ yr read from ongoing rebound (~1 cm/yr) plus the measured mantle relaxation time, with no calendar date and no assumed rate; a present-tense observable that does NOT promote the cascade's occurrence past [O].

Any claim that the coupled sequence (or any face) occurred in Earth history is capped at [O] (Art. 1.2), decided only by independent dating; the firewall is bidirectional — it withholds both 'deep time' and 'recent'.
